131
Called Meeting of the City Council
April 22d 1882.
W. H. Taylor.
Mayor Presiding

Roll call present. Aldermen Netz Kinney Schuler Bruggerhoff Radky Wilson Oswald Cook
Chapman, Norther Platt.

Call of the Council read, which was for the Consideration of matters pertaining to
Railroads.

The following Aldermen were each fined one dollar for non attendance at this meeting
Cook W. Kupperly Norther Platt.

Alderman Bruggerhoff offered and ordinance Granting the International & Great Northern R R
permission to cross Congress Avenue Provided that they keep the crossing in good repair On
motion of Alderman Bruggerhoff the ordinance was referred to a special committee of 3
Aldermen the mayor and the following ie the Committee W. H. Taylor Mayor J. H. Walton City
attorney Aldermen Bruggerhoff Radky & Netz.

On motion of Alderman Bruggerhoff the'
Council adjourned

Thomas L. Purnell
City Clerk
